verified_facts.text: San Ysidro Ranch is set in the leafy foothills of Santa Barbara.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tucked away in the leafy foothills of Santa Barbara, San Ysidro Ranch offers a unique blend of privacy, peace, and tranquility in an idyllic setting.

verified_facts.text: Guests stay in vine-covered cottages surrounded by landscaped gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thirty-eight vine-covered cottages surrounded by incredibly landscaped gardens with flowers always in bloom

verified_facts.text: Individually decorated cottages have a gated entry with an enclosed garden and adjacent private parking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Individually decorated cottages feature a gated entry with an enclosed garden and adjacent private parking.

verified_facts.text: Cottage furnishings include Persian rugs, stone fireplaces, king-sized four-poster beds, oversized sunken spas and outdoor rainfall showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Furnishings include Persian rugs, stone fireplaces, king-sized four-poster beds, oversized sunken spas, and outdoor rainfall showers.

verified_facts.text: Dining at the Ranch is included complimentary with each stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ranch offers a range of premier dining experiences, all included complimentary with each stay

verified_facts.text: Herbs and vegetables for the restaurants come from the onsite chef's garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: showcasing a rich palette of herbs and vegetables sourced from the onsite chef's garden

verified_facts.text: The Stonehouse restaurant is set inside a 19th-century citrus packing house.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set inside a 19th-century citrus packing house

verified_facts.text: The Stonehouse has an ocean-view terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather in the lounge and dine under the romantic lights of the ocean-view terrace

verified_facts.text: The Speakeasy, inspired by Prohibition-era bars, offers handcrafted cocktails, rare spirits and live music nightly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the clandestine bars of Prohibition, The Speakeasy is an intimate escape of handcrafted cocktails, rare spirits, and live music nightly.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea is served in the Veranda with house-made pastries, seasonal scones and tea sandwiches.
verified_facts.excerpt: A cherished Ranch tradition, Afternoon Tea unfolds in the Veranda with house-made pastries, seasonal scones, and refined tea sandwiches

verified_facts.text: The Veranda offers fireside dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Veranda offers fireside dining and is renowned for its afternoon tea and special celebrations.

verified_facts.text: Chef Matt Johnson joined San Ysidro Ranch in 2008.
verified_facts.excerpt: Matt joined the elite team at San Ysidro Ranch in 2008.

verified_facts.text: In 2014 Chef Matt Johnson cooked a five-course dinner at The James Beard House featuring Meyer lemons grown on the Ranch's grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2014, Matt was given the honor of crafting a five-course dinner at The James Beard House, featuring the Meyer Lemons grown here on the grounds of the San Ysidro Ranch.

verified_facts.text: John Huston finished writing the screenplay for The African Queen while staying at the Ranch.
verified_facts.excerpt: John Huston, who finished writing the screenplay for The African Queen while in residence

verified_facts.text: Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh exchanged midnight wedding vows on the grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh exchanged midnight wedding vows on the grounds

verified_facts.text: John and Jackie Kennedy honeymooned at the Ranch in the cottage that now bears their name.
verified_facts.excerpt: John and Jackie Kennedy honeymooning in the cottage that now bears their name

verified_facts.text: Past guests include Groucho Marx and Winston Churchill.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ranch has a historical guest list: Groucho Marx, Winston Churchill, Sinclair Lewis, and John Huston

verified_facts.text: The Pampered Pet Program is offered in pet-friendly cottages, with pet bedding and a water bowl placed in the cottage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Plush San Ysidro Ranch pet bedding and water bowl placed in cottage

verified_facts.text: A pet-friendly in-room dining menu is available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly in-room dining menu available

verified_facts.text: Pets are not permitted in the restaurants, bars, salon and spa, fitness center or pool areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are not permitted in the hotel’s restaurants, bars, salon & spa, fitness center, or pool areas

verified_facts.excerpt: Ty Warner spared no expense when he purchased San Ysidro Ranch in 2000.

verified_facts.text: Cottage interiors include artfully lit in-room libraries and hand-painted wallpaper in the bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Artfully lit in-room libraries, hand-painted wallpaper in the bathrooms that even lines the ceilings of the showers, authentic antiques, and museum-quality art

verified_facts.text: Cottages such as Laurel are set along San Ysidro Creek.

verified_facts.text: The property has a pool and its own golf-putting course.

verified_facts.text: The Ranch has a 14,000-bottle wine cellar with a 70-vintage vertical collection of Chateau Petrus dating back to 1945.
verified_facts.excerpt: 14,000-bottle wine cellar with a 70-vintage vertical collection of Château Petrus dating back to 1945
